source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS) — Riadni členovia
why_relevant: Explicit 'riadni členovia' page listing leasing/consumer-finance companies, many of them bank subsidiaries (a non-bank credit actor population that regulator lists fragment).

source_name: SASP — Slovenská asociácia sprostredkovateľov v poisťovníctve
why_relevant: Insurance-brokerage association; member and board lists complete the distribution-side actor map alongside AFISP.

source_name: Republiková únia zamestnávateľov (RÚZ) — Členovia
why_relevant: Employer confederation with mixed membership (sector unions plus individual corporates such as Slovnaft, Tesco, IBM, U.S. Steel). RÚZ is a tripartite social partner, so its positions and its member roster surface employment/labour-cost changes; financial-sector members appear via sector unions.

source_name: AZZZ SR — Členovia (Asociácia zamestnávateľských zväzov a združení SR)
why_relevant: The other tripartite employer confederation; its member-union list is a directory-of-directories (each zväz has its own member companies), useful for mapping employer-side actors and labour-relations signals affecting finance-sector staffing.

source_name: Slovenská obchodná a priemyselná komora (SOPK)
why_relevant: Public-law chamber with regional offices; member database and event/committee activity give a broad company directory and named regional officeholders. Public-law status means its bodies are documented.

source_name: Britcham — British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic, Our Members
why_relevant: ~120 member organisations incl. UK-linked financial and professional-services firms; smaller but higher-signal-per-entry directory, and Britcham event pages name speakers with titles.

source_name: AHK Slowakei — Deutsch-Slowakische Industrie- und Handelskammer
why_relevant: German-Slovak bilateral chamber (founded 2005); German-owned banks/insurers and shared-service centres are members. Its member directory and board are a further actor/officeholder source; language dimension adds a third (de) beyond sk/en.

source_name: Slovenská asociácia finančníkov (SAF) — CFO/treasury professional body
why_relevant: EACT member uniting CFOs, treasurers, tax specialists and auditors; its committees, conference programmes and award juries name finance executives with employers — a named-officeholder directory for corporate finance, and a recruiting pool for bank senior roles.

source_name: FinStat / Transparex company registries as association-entity resolvers
why_relevant: Associations are themselves registered legal entities; FinStat/Transparex expose their statutory representatives and changes. Useful to resolve association officeholders and to enrich every member company found in the directories above with statutory-body change history — a hard organizational-change signal.

source_name: Sector trade press as association-signal amplifier (Banky.sk, SITA vo financiách, Index SME, Teraz.sk, FinReport)
why_relevant: These outlets reliably report association elections and executive appointments (e.g. SBA presidency, SBA executive-director hire, AOCP committee elections), often with fuller name/title detail and dates than the associations' own pages, and they cover associations that publish nothing.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of Slovak associations (SAPIE, ITAS, AmCham, Klub 500, SAF, Britcham)
why_relevant: Associations announce new board members, executive hires and working-group launches on LinkedIn first; the pages also expose associated people. This is the fastest-moving leadership-move channel for this cell — but access is restricted and scraping is against ToS.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava — Speakers page
why_relevant: Largest SK fintech/banking conference (10th edition 13-14 Oct 2026, Jurkovicova Teplaren). Speaker cards carry person name + employer and frequently exact job title (verified examples: 'Dusan Jurcak, Executive Director, Narodna banka Slovenska'; 'Peter Penzes, Head of Crypto-assets and Innovation Section, NBS'; 'Oleg Pittner, Tatra banka'). A dated roster of who holds which function in SK banking/payments.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava — Agenda / Program
why_relevant: Session-level agenda pairs panel topics (payments, digital euro, regulation) with named panellists and their employers; a first-time title such as 'Head of Instant Payments' on a panel is direct evidence of a new function at a SK institution.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava 2026 — Eventbrite listing
why_relevant: Mirror of the conference agenda with dates and session descriptions; useful as a fallback when the organiser site changes structure, and Eventbrite search is itself a pointer to smaller SK fintech meetups.

source_name: ZBK — Zdruzenie pre bankove karty, Podujatia (events)
why_relevant: The Slovak bank-card association runs the country's card/payments training and conference calendar (verified 2026 items: 'Zaklady kartoveho biznisu II - Vydavanie kariet' 8.9.2026, 'Akceptacia kariet' 10.9.2026, 'Bezpecnost platieb' 24.9.2026, 'Trendy v digitalnych platbach' 8.10.2026, 'Den bez hotovosti - Digitalna identita' 5.11.2026). Lecturers on these events are practising card/payments managers at SK banks and processors — the closest thing to a SK cards org-chart snapshot.

source_name: Narodna banka Slovenska — Konferencie a podujatia
why_relevant: Central-bank hosted conferences (e.g. innovation/fintech conference held 28 Oct 2025) publish panel line-ups naming NBS section heads and commercial-bank executives; NBS titles are authoritative and change with reorganisations.

source_name: IBV NBS (Institut bankoveho vzdelavania NBS) — FinNext conference series
why_relevant: FinNext (spring edition 24 Mar 2026 on AML & Compliance; autumn edition from 5 Oct 2026) is the training arm of the central bank; its speaker lists are explicitly 'experts from practice and regulation — NBS representatives, leaders of major financial companies, fintech innovators', i.e. named compliance/AML/payments function holders. Also indicates which compliance functions banks are staffing up.

source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia (SBA) — official site
why_relevant: Banking-association site is the natural host/announcer for a Slovak banking congress and for working-group membership; association project pages and press releases name bank representatives with function titles. Treat as pointer to congress/event pages that searches did not surface directly.

source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Association posts event photos/announcements tagging attending bank executives with current titles; LinkedIn event pages for SK banking conferences also expose attendee/speaker identities. Strong cross-check for a title first seen on an agenda.

source_name: FINAS — Fintech & Insurtech Asociacia Slovenska, Eventy
why_relevant: Runs the recurring FINAS Meetup series (#14 on 26 Mar 2025, Pribinova 40 Bratislava; #17 bundled into Finweek 2026). Meetup pages and recaps name speakers from SK fintechs, payment institutions and banks — an early-signal source for new payments functions before they appear in press releases.

source_name: Slovenska Fintech asociacia — Eventy / Novinky
why_relevant: Predecessor/parallel association site (founded Aug 2018) aggregating SK fintech event announcements including banking-adjacent conferences; useful as a pointer feed to events not indexed by search engines.

source_name: Zlata minca — awards site (nominations + results)
why_relevant: 20-year-old SK financial-product award (2025 results announced 29 Oct 2025 at Hotel Tatra, day one of Finweek). Publishes per-category nomination and result tables (debit cards, credit cards, 13 banking categories) plus a 210-member expert jury whose members are named finance practitioners with employers — a large, dated roster of who works where. Also co-organises the Top Slovak Fintech Awards with FINAS.

source_name: TREND TOP — Banka roka (Slovak business weekly ranking/award)
why_relevant: TREND TOP names 'Banka roka' on financial indicators (VUB banka won for 2025) and runs an accompanying awards gala/conference where bank CEOs speak and are quoted with titles; TREND event coverage is a reliable dated marker of who represents each bank publicly.

source_name: The Banker — Bank of the Year Awards (Slovakia) and bank press releases about it
why_relevant: Tatra banka was named Slovak Bank of the Year 2025 by The Banker. Award write-ups and the winning bank's own press release quote the executives who own the initiative, with exact titles — a low-noise way to attach names to strategic functions (digital, private banking).

source_name: Profesia Days Bratislava — exhibitor list
why_relevant: Slovakia's largest job festival (Bratislava 22-23 Apr 2026, Stara trznica; exhibitor list released progressively from March). Which banks/payment firms buy a stand — and how large — is a direct signal of active hiring expansion in SK; exhibitor pages link to the employer's open-roles page.

source_name: Narodne dni kariery (AIESEC Slovakia job fair)
why_relevant: Long-running student/graduate job fair (18+ editions, Bratislava and Kosice) organised by AIESEC; participating-company lists and stand programmes reveal which banks target graduate pipelines and for which job families. Complements Profesia Days at the entry-level end.

source_name: Kariera EXPO Kosice (zoznam.sk job fair)
why_relevant: Eastern-Slovakia career fair; exhibitor roster shows which banks/shared-service and payments operations recruit outside Bratislava — relevant because SK banking back-office/IT hubs are increasingly in Kosice.

source_name: ATMIA Europe & Emerging Markets Roadshow
why_relevant: ATM industry association's European events (2026 roadshow: Berlin, Madrid) draw cash-cycle and self-service heads from CEE banks and independent ATM deployers; agendas name speakers with exact ATM/cash-management titles — the only reliable window on a function SK banks rarely publicise.
